title: The TNT Update
description: This mod adds a bunch of cool new types of TNT to the game.
body:
This mod was made with MCreator. It adds a bunch of new cool types of TNT including:
| Name | Action | Main crafting recipe / description of main crafting recipe | Side block texture / description of side block texture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2x TNT | Makes an explosion with the power of 2 | ![2 normal TNT side by side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e6a999de1f88bcbd708f1dfeafb52dae621612f.png) | ![Purple TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c92c750ea8bddd173c15b59d0f64ce39b3866a3.png)
| 5x TNT | Makes an explosion with the power of 5 | ![4 normal TNT in all four corners of the crafting table with one in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0a746937e705a86fddb55c658f8ffd977e02db7.png) | ![Yellow TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7441fe537bf32d25ba7a2670a5179feb2bba6210.png) |
| 10x TNT | Makes an explosion with the power of 10 | ![Two 5x TNTs side by side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b25c763cfad08d68b8775e2683227781149f00c4.png) | ![Blue TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e04572e0187ff5b75c75228df26a8f756b3e27f1.png) |
| Immediate TNT | Makes a normal explosion but explodes instantly | ![One normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with redstone dust surrounding on all sides](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21ae258d5674484449ffbe8ee81bca182453194d.png) | ![Dark gray TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69c84bf577844ac31ba92b39ffe811b1f36a24d5.png) |
| Nuclear TNT | Makes an huge, fiery explosion | ![4 fire charges in the corners of the crafting table with two 10x TNTs on each side (horizontally), two blaze powder on each side (vertically), and a nether star in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6e91d6e577bcabbce324119c541a0f5d5f46568.png) | ![Yellowish-orange TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bce4bbc329e2b6a39f5c34ab4a43e3eef56cba4c.png) |
| Hole TNT | Makes a big hole in the ground | ![Six TNT all side by side on the bottom of the crafting table with a piston in the top middle and redstone dust on each side (horizontally) of the piston](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c182006f43396cc491a222c8f3669cdcdb14a927.png) | ![Orange TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/659c863dde86e727da6fcd244fc96cb11ab995d0.png) |
| Diamond Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of diamond ore | ![One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with diamond ore surrounding on all sides](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d79a3107c9286195d0b8238ce1bb3af1c25b700.png) | ![Diamond ore but with the TNT label on it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b7a6dea5b398768321c2505997b4e635843837d.png) |
| Deepslate Diamond Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate diamond ore | ![One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate diamond ore surrounding on all sides](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b72bee8bca4764b45209005ee8068577fb1f74da.png) | ![Deepslate diamond ore but with the TNT label on it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d70f38d769fa557bb75412138e7e310f0640d914.png) |
| Emerald Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of emerald ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with emerald ore surrounding on all sides | Emerald ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Emerald Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate emerald ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate emerald ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate emerald ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Redstone Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of redstone ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with redstone ore surrounding on all sides | Redstone ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Redstone Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate redstone ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate redstone ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate redstone ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Gold Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of gold ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with gold ore surrounding on all sides | Gold ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Gold Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate gold ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate gold ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate gold ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Nether Gold Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of Nether gold ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with Nether gold ore surrounding on all sides | Nether gold ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Iron Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of iron ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with iron ore surrounding on all sides | Iron ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Iron Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate iron ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate iron ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate iron ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Coal Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of coal ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with coal ore surrounding on all sides | Coal ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Coal Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate coal ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate coal ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate coal ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Copper Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of copper ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with copper ore surrounding on all sides | Copper ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Copper Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate copper ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate copper ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate copper ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Lapis Lazuli Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of lapis lazuli ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with lapis lazuli ore surrounding on all sides | Lapis lazuli ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Deepslate Lapis Lazuli Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of deepslate lapis lazuli ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with deepslate lapis lazuli ore surrounding on all sides | Deepslate lapis lazuli ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Nether Quartz Ore TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of Nether quartz ore | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with nether quartz ore surrounding on all sides | Nether quartz ore but with the TNT label on it |
| Ancient Debris TNT | Makes a 3 by 3 by 3 cube of ancient debris | One piece of normal TNT in the middle of the crafting table with ancient debris surrounding on all sides | Ancient debris but with the TNT label on it |
| World Eater TNT | Will literally slowly eat your world | ![First slot contains a Nether star, second slot contains an enchanted golden apple, third slot contains a dragon head, fourth slot contains a dragon egg, fifth slot contains a piece normal tnt, sixth slot contains a heart of the sea, seventh slot contains a heavy core, eighth slot contains a totem of undying, ninth slot contains an elytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1589e11a6964cdc648f7914806e042f0bbe4bbf2.png) | ![Solid black TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1a635ea87aedd0f8815b7f4029c51756fa9e1ab.png)
| Ice TNT | Turns all blocks in a nearby radius into ice | ![One piece of TNT in the middle of the crafting table with ice surrounding on all sides](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc8feafb830bed3117cc37d2f3d106c2dbc1af1c.png) | ![A block of ice with the TNT label on it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/299d25d53b6270787d742f6a09ecb86899ce70e4.png)
| Nether TNT | Turns all blocks in a nearby radius into Nether blocks | ![One piece of TNT in the middle of the crafting table with Netherrack surrounding on all sides](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e8c81e68606c0465d1059fba6f024df5fb53dfb.png) | ![TNT but the background color is the average color of Netherrack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78fbcf0d5b1d8fc1baff14b4bd373bf4ac20b6ae.png) |
